# Diego Ramil Alvarez

> Diego Ramil Alvarez (also written Diego Ramil Álvarez) is a Full Stack Developer based in Narón, Galicia (Spain), focused on JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Astro, Node.js and modern web development. AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate.

## Profile

- [Portfolio](https://diegoramil.com/): experience, projects, certifications and contact links
- Current work: Full Stack Developer at Landra Sistemas (July 2023 - present), with React, Spring Boot, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Domain-Driven Design and Scrum
- Previous work: intern (dual vocational training) at Grupo Tecnológico Artabria (January 2023 - June 2023), with Microsoft SQL Server, Microsoft Azure, .NET Framework, jQuery, Bootstrap and Domain-Driven Design
- Education: Higher Vocational Degree in Web Application Development, CIFP Rodolfo Ucha Piñeiro (2021 - 2023)
- Certification: [AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate](https://www.credly.com/badges/b29c8bfc-97bf-42a7-8270-a1904c76b443/), issued 30 January 2026, expires January 2029
- Certification: Desarrollo Seguro ante Ciberataques (secure development against cyberattacks), Vitae Consultores, June 2025

## Projects

- [Pi-hole Nodes Sync](https://github.com/DiegoRamil/pihole-nodes-sync): syncs Pi-hole nodes from a central server, making it a highly available DNS server
- [Portfolio](https://github.com/DiegoRamil/portfolio-astro): this website, built with Astro and Tailwind CSS
- [Actions PR Update](https://github.com/DiegoRamil/actions-pr-auto-update): fork of a GitHub Action that updates open pull requests when the base branch changes
